title: Critique: it is too counterintuitive to take seriously

statements.text: Many philosophers and non-philosophers find it deeply counterintuitive that electrons have experience, and take that as reason enough not to take panpsychism seriously. Even a critic who grants it a hearing starts by taking it as extremely counterintuitive and metaphysically demanding.

sources.quote: Many people, both philosophers and non-philosophers, find deeply counterintuitive the idea that fundamental constituents of the physical world, such as electrons, have conscious experience.
this view is extremely counterintuitive and metaphysically demanding
